architecture.rationale: Clear feature/modules split with MVVM, Hilt DI, Supabase backend. Minor cross-cutting state glue. Verified via src/ layout and viewmodel/ structure.

code_quality.rationale: Consistent style, some duplicated helpers, hardcoded bank details (mock), mock data residue in AuthRepository. Verified via search_files and read_file.

security.rationale: No service_role key in client. RLS policies present with is_admin() function. Input sanitization via InputSanitizer. Encrypted SharedPreferences. BUT: hardcoded mock bank details, no certificate pinning, no MFA. Verified via grep and read_file.

testing.rationale: 10 test files, 159 tests total. 12 failures (all android.util.Log not mocked — infrastructure issue, not code bugs). No auth/role-gate tests. No integration/E2E tests. Verified via testDebugUnitTest and XML results.

documentation.rationale: README exists but minimal. No .env.example, no API docs, no setup guide, no architecture docs. Verified via ls and read_file.

deployment.rationale: GitHub Releases with self-updater. Supabase free tier (pause risk after ~1 week idle). No CI/CD pipeline. No backup strategy. No monitoring. Verified via build.gradle.kts and supabase.properties.

performance.rationale: ~10MB APK. Realtime subscriptions for messaging. No obvious memory leaks. Cold start acceptable. Verified via APK size and code inspection.

maintainability.rationale: Clear module structure with Hilt DI. Some hardcoded values (bank details, fees). Consistent naming. Verified via src/ layout.

critical.title: No invoice generation on approval — finance tabs always empty
critical.problem: When admin approves an application, no invoices are created. The finance tabs (parent and admin) will always show empty because there are no invoice records in the database.
critical.impact: Parents cannot see what they owe. Admin cannot track payments. The entire finance system is non-functional.
critical.evidence: Verified — createStudentFromApplication() in SupabaseRepository.kt creates student + medical + collection + sports records but never calls createInvoice(). No invoice generation exists anywhere in the codebase.
critical.action: Add invoice generation to createStudentFromApplication(): create registration fee invoice (R450) + transport invoice (R600/month if transportRequired). Call createInvoice() after student creation.

critical.title: Mock bank details in production code
critical.problem: Banking details are hardcoded mock values: First National Bank, Account 62845679012, Branch 250655. These are visible to all users in the app.
critical.impact: Parents will attempt to pay to a non-existent account. Real payments will fail. Potential fraud risk if someone uses these details.
critical.evidence: Verified — RegistrationPaymentScreen.kt lines 249-253 and FinancePaymentScreen.kt lines 221-225 contain hardcoded mock bank details. banking_details.md in assets also contains mock data.
critical.action: Replace with real business bank details. Consider making them configurable from Supabase dashboard so they can be updated without app rebuild.

important.title: No monthly fee calculation system
important.problem: There is no system to calculate or generate monthly school fees, transport fees, or aftercare fees. The finance system only shows manually created invoices.
important.impact: School cannot automate billing. Every invoice must be created manually. Parents never receive recurring monthly invoices.
important.evidence: Verified — no fee calculation logic exists in codebase. InvoiceCategory enum has REGISTRATION, AFTERCARE, TRANSPORT, STATIONERY but no generation logic.
important.action: Build a fee calculation system: define fee structure per grade, generate monthly invoices on a configurable date, track due dates and overdue status.

important.title: No auth/role-gate tests
important.problem: No tests verify that parent role cannot access admin screens or vice versa. RouteGuard and RequireParent/RequireAdmin are untested.
important.impact: Role-based access control regressions would ship unnoticed. Security-critical authorization logic is unverified.
important.evidence: Verified — test files cover data models, repository, input sanitizer, routes. No test references RouteGuard, RequireParent, RequireAdmin, or role-based access.
important.action: Add tests for RouteGuard: verify parent cannot navigate to admin routes, verify admin cannot navigate to parent routes, verify unauthenticated users are redirected.

important.title: Supabase free tier pause risk
important.problem: Supabase free tier pauses after ~1 week of inactivity. All API calls then fail and the app becomes non-functional.
important.impact: Full app outage if project is not accessed for a week. Parents and admin cannot use the app until project is manually resumed.
important.evidence: Verified — supabase.properties contains free-tier project URL. No keep-alive ping or monitoring configured.
important.action: Add a daily keep-alive ping (cronjob hitting /rest/v1/profiles?select=count) to prevent pause. Document recovery steps in README.

important.title: No CI/CD pipeline
important.problem: No automated build, test, or deployment pipeline. Releases are built and published manually.
important.impact: Human error risk in release process. No automated regression testing. Slow release cycle.
important.evidence: Verified — no .github/workflows, no Jenkins, no CI config. Build is done via local gradlew assembleRelease.
important.action: Add GitHub Actions workflow: build → test → lint → publish release on tag push.

important.title: No backup strategy
important.problem: No database backup strategy. Supabase free tier has limited backup options. No export/restore process documented.
important.impact: Data loss if Supabase project is corrupted or accidentally deleted. No recovery path.
important.evidence: Verified — no backup scripts, no export process, no backup documentation in README.
important.action: Document Supabase backup options. Consider weekly pg_dump exports to cloud storage. Add restore procedure to README.

improvements.title: Add certificate pinning for Supabase API
improvements.action: Use OkHttp CertificatePinner with Supabase API fingerprint to prevent MITM attacks.

improvements.title: Add MFA for admin accounts
improvements.action: Enable TOTP in Supabase Auth for admin role to prevent unauthorized access.

improvements.title: Make fees configurable from Supabase
improvements.action: Store fee amounts in a Supabase config table so they can be changed without app rebuild.

improvements.title: Add payment reminder notifications
improvements.action: Send automated reminders before due date and after overdue via Supabase notifications.

improvements.title: Add date filters to admin finance tabs
improvements.action: Allow admin to filter payments/invoices by date range for better management.
